brief: 5 things that actually close enterprise deals — from a 7-figure sales leader.

slots.author: Marcus Reid
slots.headline: 5 Closers That Win Enterprise Deals
slots.body: I’ve closed 7-figure contracts for a decade. These five moves separate the reps who win from those who ghost after procurement.

slots.author: Marcus Reid
slots.title: Map Your Economic Buyer
slots.body: Don't stop at the user. Identify who controls budget, who signs, and who cares about ROI. Then sell to all three.

slots.author: Marcus Reid
slots.title: Quantify The Business Pain
slots.body: If you can't put a dollar cost on their problem, you're just another vendor. Build the business case together.

slots.author: Marcus Reid
slots.title: Multithread The Account
slots.body: Single-threaded deals die in reorgs. Build three relationships minimum so one departure doesn't kill momentum.

slots.author: Marcus Reid
slots.title: Sell The Internal Meeting
slots.body: Your champion isn't a salesperson. Give them the deck, the narrative, and the objections to handle inside their company.

slots.author: Marcus Reid
slots.title: Control The Procurement Timeline
slots.body: Never let legal or security become a black hole. Set weekly milestones and assign owners to every block.

slots.author: Marcus Reid
slots.title: Start Using These Today
slots.body: Pick the gap in your current deals and apply it this week. The best reps iterate fast.
